# The Black File Starter Brief

A practical entry brief for readers who want the Matrix Reprogrammed map, Epstein/elite-file evidence boundary, Black File route, and first book path without getting lost in the archive.

## Branded PDF Mini Book

- PDF: downloads/lead-magnet-black-file-brief.pdf

## Boundary

Lead magnets are public orientation assets with a seven-day intelligence window. They do not increase evidence strength or replace trust/privacy pages.

## Promise

Get the clean starting route into the archive: what to open first, how to separate evidence from theory, and how to follow the Black File trail without losing the source boundary.

## Reader Outcome

The reader leaves knowing where to start, which files matter first, what evidence class means, and which deeper book route to open next.
